justification: Fixes a production outage of several API routes; one config default, no data written.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The client's pool host is not PGHOST when PGHOST is set, or a Supabase host gets no SSL.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Production /api/clause/175335 returned 'connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432' on 2026-10-26; routes using pool-manager (PGHOST) work.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Against the old constructor the first test receives host 127.0.0.1 and fails.

pre_impl.existing_data: lib/database/pool-manager.ts reads PGHOST || DATABASE_HOST; routes using it serve data in production, so Vercel sets PGHOST (DATABASE_HOST would already have fixed this client).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the preview had no database; production gave the same error on the same route, so the fault was this client. First fix changed postgres-compliance-client.ts; the preview still failed because /api/clause uses lib/database/client.ts, a second client with the same fault.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new module; the default config now matches pool-manager. Reusing the shared pool was rejected because callers call close(), which would end the shared pool.

functions.name: PostgreSQLComplianceClient.constructor
functions.what: Builds the pg pool from environment variables when no config is passed.
functions.input: optional DatabaseConfig object, otherwise environment variables PG*, DB_*, DATABASE_*
functions.output: a client holding a pg Pool connected to the configured database host
functions.if_none: Falls back to 127.0.0.1 only when no host variable at all is set (local development).
functions.edge_cases: Supabase pooler host gets SSL even when NODE_ENV is not production (preview).
functions.failure_mode: A wrong host fails loudly with ECONNREFUSED; it cannot serve wrong data.

functions.name: DatabaseClient.constructor
functions.what: Builds the pg pool used by /api/clause, setbacks/calculate and the geometry calculator.
functions.input: optional partial PostgreSQLConfig, otherwise environment variables PG* then DATABASE_*
functions.output: a client holding a pg Pool connected to the configured database host
functions.if_none: Falls back to localhost only when no host variable is set.
functions.edge_cases: Supabase pooler host gets SSL outside production.
functions.failure_mode: Wrong host fails loudly with ECONNREFUSED; no wrong data.

break_it.what_happens: Old code connected to 127.0.0.1 and every route failed.
Local development that only sets DB_HOST must still connect to its database.
break_it.how: DB_HOST remains in the chain after PGHOST.

break_it.what_happens: A preview deployment would be refused by Supabase because no SSL was requested.
break_it.how: SSL on for supabase/pooler hosts, same as pool-manager.
break_it.repro: test asserts ssl for a pooler host

verified: production error reproduced before the fix
gaps: Not verified on Vercel until deploy: confirm /api/clause/175335 returns the rule.
